title: Senior Lead - Software Product Manager
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Lead, Software Product Manager to own and drive the vision, roadmap, and execution for a critical product area. In this role, you will be responsible for aligning cross-functional teams, developing product strategies, and delivering solutions that directly impact customer adoption, satisfaction, and company objectives.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to define product direction, prioritize initiatives, and ensure successful delivery of features that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Work Schedule
This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in your time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Product Ownership: Serve as the product owner for a defined product area, responsible for defining strategy, creating roadmaps, and driving product adoption that impacts company goals.

•
Strategic Vision: Develop and execute a clear product vision that aligns with business objectives, with a strong understanding of current state and future needs.

•
Cross-Functional Leadership: Work across departments (Engineering, Data, Cloud) to manage dependencies, align teams to roadmaps, and drive initiatives to resolution with minimal oversight.

•
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with internal teams and external customers to gather requirements, harmonize strategies across multiple customer needs, and influence customer planning.

•
Metrics & Accountability: Define, track, and report on key performance indicators including adoption rates, customer satisfaction, and other business-critical metrics.

•
Mentorship: Begin mentoring peers and colleagues, contributing to the growth and development of the product management team.

•
Decision Making: Navigate ambiguity with confidence, making sound decisions that help teams move forward with clarity while knowing when to escalate to accelerate resolution.

•
Communication: Deliver outstanding written and verbal communication to a diverse stakeholder audience, including C-level executives, product teams, and technical stakeholders.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• 12 or more years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years of experience.

• 5 or more years of experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional teams.

ADDITIONAL JOB STANDARDS

• Current or previous Labcorp experience.

• Proven track record of owning product areas and delivering results that directly impact business outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity to clarity.

description:

Reporting to the Manager, IT Quality Assurance, the QA Lead owns the quality assurance strategy and execution for a new enterprise data platform that consolidates data from multiple source systems, including SAP and CRM, into a centralized source on AWS. This contract role defines the test strategy, plans, cases, and quality gates required to validate end-to-end data integration and support confident release decisions. The QA Lead directs the QA Tester, oversees defect analysis and resolution across QA and Production environments, and reports testing progress, risks, results, and quality metrics to stakeholders. Success in this role requires an investigative mindset and the ability to interrogate data, identify anomalies, determine root causes, and ensure that the platform meets organizational standards and business expectations for completeness, accuracy, integrity, and reliability.
This 12 month contract requires residency in Canada.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Test Strategy & Planning: Define and own the overall QA strategy, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for the data integration platform, ensuring comprehensive coverage of interfaces, data flows, business rules, and the consolidated target across SAP, CRM, and other applicable source systems.

• Integration Testing: Lead end-to-end integration testing across source systems such as SAP and CRM, verifying that interfaces, transformations, dependencies, and data flows operate correctly from source through the consolidated platform.

• Data Validation: Design and oversee data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality checks that confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of integrated data. Partner with development teams to investigate discrepancies, reproduce failures, isolate root causes, validate corrective actions, and confirm resolution.

• Team Leadership: Provide direction and mentorship to the QA Tester, coordinate day-to-day testing activities, and ensure alignment on priorities and quality standards.

• Reporting & Quality Gates: Establish measurable entry, exit, and release-readiness criteria across QA and Production environments. Produce reports and metrics that summarize test coverage, execution status, defect trends, unresolved risks, and readiness recommendations to support go/no-go release decisions.

• Stakeholder Communication: Regularly communicate test progress, coverage, risks, and results to project stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with project goals.

• Defect Management: Lead defect analysis, triage, prioritization, tracking, and resolution across QA and Production environments. Work with development partners to reproduce issues, assess impact, confirm root cause, validate fixes, and communicate unresolved risks.

• Proven, hands-on experience testing enterprise data integrations across SAP, SAP S/4HANA, customer relationship management systems, and Microsoft Dynamics is required. Some might be ordering for the first time. Others have been buying from us for years. Some need an occasional reminder or a well-timed offer, while others represent significant opportunities that deserve a much more personalized approach.

Today, we reach these customers through emails, SMS, automated journeys, promotional campaigns, gifting programs, and direct outreach. We've built much of the infrastructure to make these things possible, but there's a much bigger opportunity ahead of us: bringing all of these touchpoints together into a thoughtful, cohesive strategy for how we grow our customer relationships.

That's what we're hiring a Growth Strategist to do.

Your job is to understand our customers, figure out what they need at different stages of their relationship with Fresh Prints , and build experiences that make them want to engage, purchase, return, and grow with us.

For some customers, that might mean a great email at exactly the right moment. For others, it might mean an entirely different experience, with personalized outreach, exclusive offers, samples, or programs designed around their long-term potential.

We don't want someone who thinks about growth as a collection of campaigns or channels. We want someone who can see the bigger picture, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into programs that drive meaningful business results.

This isn't a role where you inherit a finished playbook. You'll have the freedom, and responsibility, to question how we do things today, build better systems, and shape what customer growth looks like at Fresh Prints .

This role is about:

•
Understanding our customers deeply: Who they are, what they care about, why they buy, what brings them back, and what makes them disengage.

•
Designing the right experience for different customers: Knowing when automation and great content are enough, and when a relationship deserves a more personalized, high-touch approach.

•
Finding opportunities to grow customer value: Identifying where we're losing customers, leaving revenue on the table, or missing opportunities to build stronger relationships.

•
Being a great marketer: Understanding what makes someone open an email, click a link, respond to an offer, or take the next step, and being able to create that experience yourself.

•
Turning ideas into execution: Building programs, writing compelling content, coordinating teams, testing approaches, and taking ownership of the results.

•
Building systems that scale: Using data, technology, AI, and automation to create experiences that become smarter and more effective over time.

What You'll Own

Understanding Customers & Finding Growth Opportunities

• Develop a deep understanding of Fresh Prints ' customers, their buying behavior, motivations, needs, and decision-making journeys.

• Use customer insights, data, and commercial judgment to identify the biggest opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, and customer value.

• Identify where different customers need different experiences, and determine where we should invest more time, effort, and resources.

Building Experiences That Drive Growth

• Own how Fresh Prints engages with customers throughout their relationship with us, from their first interaction to becoming loyal, repeat customers.

• Develop thoughtful customer journeys that bring together content, communication, offers, personalization, and outreach to move customers toward the next meaningful action.

title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Payments
description:
VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization. Large banks, aspiring fintechs, and growing merchants embed our universal token vault into their technology stack to manage the complexities of payment data tokenization across processors and networks, open banking, card issuance, omnichannel loyalty, PCI compliance, payment orchestration, and more. We empower our clients and partners by tokenizing sensitive payment data, limiting compliance scope, and consolidating payments to unlock revenue and business opportunities.
VGS provides processor-agnostic tokenization solutions via secure universal token vaults, iframes, mobile SDKs, tokenization proxies, APIs, and data orchestration tooling to support payment acceptance, card issuance, PII and bank account tokenization, and other payments value-added services. Some of the use cases we enable include multi-processor Network Tokenization, Account Updater, payment orchestration, secure settlement file processing, 3DS, and Risk provider connectivity.

In addition, this role will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing our Card Attributes, Webhooks and Event Pipeline. • Solid understanding and hands-on experience working with cloud-native architecture, microservices, CI/CD (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Argo), GitOps, APIs and API Gateway, Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Python, and AWS services.

• Strong experience implementing and leveraging Observability solutions (metrics, logging, tracing) using tools like Open Telemetry, Grafana and Prometheus to diagnose and resolve production issues.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Bonus points if you have familiarity with the payment processing ecosystem (PCI DSS, tokenization, card networks, processors).

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst / CRO to own marketing analytics, reporting and conversion rate optimisation at CoVet . You will report to the Product Marketing Manager and work closely with the performance marketing, lifecycle and product teams.

This is a hands-on role for an analyst who enjoys both the data and the decisions it drives. You will build reliable reporting, find where the funnel leaks, and run the tests that improve conversion from first visit to first record to paying subscription.

You will:

• own marketing reporting and dashboards, so teams can see funnel performance by market, channel and source

• analyse the full funnel from visit to sign-up, activation, subscription and retention, and find where conversion is lost

• design, run and read A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding and email

• improve attribution and measurement across paid channels, the website and the CRM

• Product Marketing: to improve activation and onboarding, and to prioritise conversion work

• Product and Engineering: to instrument events, ship experiments and understand in-app behaviour

You should expect to be measured on conversion and activation gains, the number and quality of tests run, the reliability of reporting, and the impact of your recommendations.

• HubSpot or another CRM as a reporting source

• Python or R for analysis

• multi-market or multi-language businesses

title: Manager, Developer Advocacy (EMEA)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for someone to run Developer Advocacy in EMEA. You’ll get to shape how developers across the region first find Temporal, and you’ll also see it through to the other end, helping our biggest customers build serious systems on it.

You’ll manage a team of advocates, but this isn’t a desk job. You’ll still give talks, run workshops, write code, and sit down with customers yourself. If it’s been a while since you built a demo from scratch, this probably isn’t the right fit.

EMEA covers a lot of ground. The UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, and the Nordics have big developer communities and some of our largest customers.

You’ll spend a lot of time with our Marketing department on events and community, and with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developer Success on customer accounts. Good relationships with all of them are your key to success.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences.

- Decide how the team splits its time between community and customer work. Sort incoming customer requests by deal size, stage, and strategic value, and make the tough calls when there’s more demand than people, without letting community work get pushed aside.

- Work with Marketing to plan where we show up in EMEA: which conferences to speak at and which meetups to start or support.

- Create and localize content that developers in the region will use, like talks, tutorials, blog posts, videos, sample apps, and livestreams.

- Find the people in local communities who care about the problems Temporal solves and help them lead, contribute to open source, and spread the word.

- Track whether it’s working: are more developers signing up, trying Temporal, and sticking around?

- Own DevDays, our onsite customer engagement program, in EMEA from start to finish. Work with the Global DevDays lead to tailor each one to the customer’s use cases.

- Spot the engineers inside each account who could become champions, and make sure someone follows up with them.

- Take what you hear from developers and customers back to Docs, Education, and Product, especially around language, data residency, and what different markets need.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, developer education, or technical community work, ideally in a developer-first company.

- People leadership experience or a clear readiness to step into it; you can coach senior individual contributors while still doing the work yourself.

- Strong hands-on technical credibility: you can build, demo, and teach, and earn the respect of senior enterprise engineers.

- An operational, execution-first mindset: you can run a repeatable program, manage intake and prioritization, and keep commitments against an SLA.

- Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, SAs, Dev Success, Product, and Marketing, and translating technical engagement into commercial impact.

- Experience operating across a linguistically and culturally diverse region and coordinating a distributed team across multiple time zones; additional European languages are a plus.

- A genuine passion for empowering developers and creating authentic, high-trust community experiences, not sales pitches.

- Familiarity with durable execution, workflow orchestration, or distributed systems (e.g., Temporal) is a strong plus.

Documentation & Operational Excellence

- Maintain accurate network documentation, including network diagrams, IP addressing schemes, port mappings, ISP inventories, and operational runbooks.

title: New Media & Social Lead
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.

NEW MEDIA & SOCIAL LEAD

Building Deepgram’s social, creator, and new media program from scratch · Reports to the Head of Brand & Awareness

THE ROLE

Deepgram is a voice company, and the internet is where voice is demoed, debated, memed, and decided. We’re hiring a Brand Social Lead to build our new media, social, and creator program from the ground up, and to make Deepgram a brand people want showing up in their feed. You’re a new media strategist. Brand-first, social-first, and very online. You know that a Substack post, a creator collab, a 30-second demo clip, a sharp X thread, and a founder’s LinkedIn post are different instruments, and you know which one to play and when. You’re plugged into the creators and communities shaping AI and developer culture, and you show up with ideas nobody has tried yet.

This is a lead role with no playbook to inherit: you’ll write it. You’ll set the strategy, make creative bets, and build the systems that drive social forward, partnering closely with creative teams, communications, DevRel, product marketing, and company leadership. We’re mid-rebrand, with a new verbal and visual identity landing now, so you’ll be defining how the new Deepgram brand shows up. You’ll report to our Senior Director, Brand Marketing.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

BUILD THE PROGRAM FROM ZERO

- Define Deepgram’s social and new media strategy: which channels we own, where we show up, how we should show up there, and what we stop doing. A strategy that easily guides when to say yes, and when to say no.

- Set the baseline, the goals, and the measurement. Define what good looks like channel by channel, benchmark against competitors, and use the data to make decisions.

- Stand up the operating system: a visible calendar, intake, review, publishing, and reporting the whole company can see and trust.

- Partner with product marketing, communications, executives, and cross-company leadership to set the social calendar - understanding what to prioritize from a company perspective as well as what works best on social.

OWN EVERY CHANNEL, NATIVELY

- Lead Deepgram’s presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouT

As the first Global Head of Tax, you will own tax across the group. You will lead the internal Tax function, set the group's tax strategy and risk appetite, and become the person the C-suite, the board, lenders, auditors and tax authorities deal with on tax.

This is a builder's role in a high-growth business, based in New York. You will be in the room when we choose how to enter a new country, how to price a new product and how to fund a new entity. You will also close out the historical items a young function accumulates, put in place the controls and reporting a large multinational needs, and turn a capable team into a function that scales.

This role reports to the COO / CFO and works cross-functionally with finance, treasury, product and market teams as the internal expert on tax across the group. In your first year, you will agree the target structure and ETR with the CFO and CEO, own the US return and the TP project, and put historical corrections on a single closing plan.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own Group Tax Strategy & Structure: Own the group's tax position: how our c.20 entities fit together, where profit and substance sit, and US international tax planning (GILTI, interest limitation, elections). Deliver a structure we can defend to any authority and an effective tax rate and cash-tax forecast the CFO and board can rely on, with tax budget and adviser spend under control.

- Lead US Tax: Own our US tax affairs: the consolidated federal return, state obligations across c.50 money-transmitter licences (nexus, apportionment, information reporting), our position on transaction taxes, and the relationship with the IRS and state authorities. Deliver a clean, on-time compliance record through outsourced advisors, building in-house capacity where necessary.

- Enable Market & Product Launches: Own tax for every new market we enter, product we ship and business we acquire. Give launch teams a clear tax decision early (entry vehicle, capitalisation, registrations, withholding, VAT, permanent establishment), diligence and integrate acquisitions, and make sure nothing is corrected after the fact that could have been right from day one.

Keep complete visibility of obligations, close historical corrections, and build a function that would pass IPO-level scrutiny on controls, documentation, Pillar Two and the diligence pack.

- Manage Indirect & Operational Taxes: Own VAT and GST in a financial-services business, employment taxes, share schemes and global mobility, and customer tax reporting (CRS 2.0, US information reporting). title: User Researcher, Merchant Operations

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
About the Role
We're looking for a User Researcher, Merchant Operations to help Bask Health better understand how merchants manage their day-to-day business operations through our software platform.
Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.
As a User Researcher, Merchant Operations, you'll investigate how business owners and operational teams use Bask Health to complete administrative tasks, manage workflows, resolve issues, and keep their businesses running efficiently.
This is a hands-on research role focused on understanding real operational behavior rather than evaluating individual interface screens in isolation.
You'll study how merchants organize their work, move between different areas of the platform, interpret operational information, and coordinate tasks involving multiple systems or stakeholders.
Your research may involve merchant dashboards, order-related workflows, subscription management, product configuration, account administration, reporting, and other operational tools.
You'll investigate where merchants encounter unnecessary steps, repetitive work, confusing processes, or limitations that make routine tasks more difficult.
A major part of this role will involve understanding how merchants complete work in practice. You'll conduct interviews, observe workflows, and evaluate how users interact with the platform during everyday business activities.
You'll also study differences between merchant segments. A small business owner managing operations independently may have different needs than an established organization with multiple team members and more specialized responsibilities.
You'll work closely with product managers to define research priorities and identify operational problems worth investigating.
You'll collaborate with product designers to evaluate workflows, improve task organization, and simplify administrative experiences.
You'll partner with engineers to understand technical constraints, system behavior, and opportunities to reduce unnecessary manual work.
You'll also collaborate with Customer Success and support teams to understand recurring merchant issues, common operational questions, and areas where merchants require additional assistance.
Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, operational workflows may involve connections between merchant activities, patient experiences, and authorized clinical or pharmacy processes. You'll research these interactions while respecting user permissions, privacy requirements, and professional boundaries.
You'll use qualitative research, usability testing, available behavioral data, and operational feedback to develop a detailed understanding of how merchants work.
You'll translate your findings into actionable recommendations that help product teams improve workflow efficiency, reduce friction, and support merchants as their businesses grow.

title: Senior Performance Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Performance Engineer is responsible for expected-versus-actual energy performance across SunStrong’s serviced fleet, spanning residential systems, commercial and industrial sites, community solar, and utility-scale projects. This role models production, quantifies and defends contractual performance obligations, and drives underperformance to root cause with operations and field services. As the senior technical authority on fleet performance, the position sets the data requirements behind performance reporting, advises on dashboard and analytics development rather than building it, and partners with asset management and O&M on billing and settlement accuracy. The role sits on the Fleet Management Technology team and requires equal comfort with a residential inverter fleet, a metered utility-scale PPA settlement, and the data platform that carries both.
Responsibilities

• Model and monitor energy performance across residential, C&I, community solar, and utility-scale assets in PlantPredict and the fleet monitoring platforms (AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, 3E), comparing metered production against simulation using weather and irradiance data from Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.

• Calculate and defend contractual performance metrics including availability, performance ratio, production guarantees, and liquidated damages exposure, and produce the recurring analysis that supports billing, PPA and lease invoicing, and investor and securitization reporting.

• Evaluate billing and settlement accuracy with the asset management and O&M teams, reconciling metered, monitored, and invoiced quantities and resolving discrepancies at the source.

• Investigate underperformance to root cause across inverters, meters, communications, energy storage, and site conditions, and drive corrective work to closure with O&M and field services.

• Direct the data requirements for fleet performance - tags, granularity, units, timestamps, and quality rules - and support data collection, ingestion, and reconciliation with the data platform team.

• Advise on the development of Power BI dashboards and performance reporting, defining metric definitions, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria, and validating output rather than building the reports directly.

• Define monitoring, revenue-grade metering, and telemetry requirements for new and retrofitted sites, and validate commissioning data before a site is accepted into the fleet.

• Establish performance baselines and data mappings for newly acquired or transitioned portfolios, including migration from legacy monitoring platforms.

• Validate storage system performance against contracted operating modes, including dispatch behavior, state of health, cycling, and demand-charge and tariff-driven response.

• Apply AI tooling and agentic workflows to accelerate fleet diagnostics, anomaly triage, and recurring analysis, and define where model output requires engineering verification before it is relied on.

• Serve as technical reviewer for warranty, insurance, and equipment claims requiring quantified production loss, and mentor junior engineers and analysts on performance methods.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical field.

• 8+ years in solar or storage performance engineering, asset performance management, or renewable O&M engineering, including 3+ years supporting commercial or utility-scale assets.

• Hands-on experience with PV performance modeling in PlantPredict (PVsyst or SAM acceptable as a secondary), and with satellite irradiance and weather datasets including Solcast, SolarAnywhere, and Open-Meteo.

• Working experience with fleet monitoring and asset performance platforms including AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, and 3E, including data extraction, tag mapping, and alarm configuration.

• Proficiency in SQL and in Python for engineering analysis (pandas, numpy, pvlib or equivalent).

• Practical fluency with

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
The Role
You will be the strategic owner of our Salesforce codebase and architecture across the entire group. You will design and build custom logic and user interfaces, connect Salesforce with our products and third-party systems, and make sure everything we ship is secure, scalable, and well within platform limits.
This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly written tickets. You will work closely with Salesforce Admins and business stakeholders, challenge requirements where needed, make architectural decisions, and proactively identify and fix problems before they affect users.
What You'll Work On

• Develop scalable custom logic with Apex classes and triggers

• Build user interfaces with Lightning Web Components, and maintain existing Aura Components and Visualforce pages

• Build and maintain API integrations connecting Salesforce with our products (Ship2Port, Routescanner), the wider group's platforms, and third-party applications

• Work across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Subscriptions, and CPQ

• Evaluate business requirements together with Salesforce Admins for security, governor limits, and scalability

• Manage release cycles and deployments across sandboxes and production using Salesforce CLI and Git

• Maintain high test coverage, follow Salesforce coding best practices, and document code effectively

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Claude) as part of your daily workflow

• Participate in architecture and technical direction decisions - your opinion will carry weight

What We're Looking For
Must-haves:

• 5+ years of professional Salesforce development experience

• Strong command of Apex (classes, triggers, asynchronous Apex) and Lightning Web Components

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Platform Events) and building integrations with external systems

• Production experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud

• Solid understanding of governor limits, the Salesforce security model, and scalable data design

• Experience with Salesforce CLI, Git-based workflows, and release management across sandboxes and production

• Salesforce Platform Developer I and Platform Developer II certifications

• Clean code as a practice - you write code your colleagues can confidently extend

• Genuine ability to self-direct: loosely defined problem -> breakdown -> delivery

Strong plus:

• Experience with Experience Cloud, Subscriptions, and CPQ

• Experience with Aura Components and Visualforce (maintaining and migrating legacy code)

• Salesforce JavaScript Developer certification

• Salesforce Architect or cloud-specific certifications

• Experience with CI/CD for Salesforce (e.g. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar)

• Background in maritime, logistics, media, or B2B SaaS

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and Salesforce AI features

How We Work

• Small team, high trust - no micromanagement, no approval chains for every decision

• Git-centric workflow - PRs, reviews, and automated pipelines keep quality high without bureaucracy

• Observability-first - we monitor, alert, and fix things before users notice

• Clean code culture - we refactor, we review, we don't let tech debt compound silently

• Periodic on-site workshops in the Torun/Bydgoszcz area (every few months)

What We Offer

• Competitive B2B rate benchmarked to your market

• Remote-friendly setup - we care about output, not location

• Group-wide impact - your work supports maritime platforms used 24/7 across Europe and a portfolio of 200+ web properties

• Real architectural ownership of the Salesforce platform, not just ticket execution

• A lean, senior team where your technical decisions actually ship

• AI tooling as a first-class part of the workflow - not an afterthought

title: Senior SOC Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior SOC Engineer
Pay Type : SALARIED EXEMPT
Location: Remote
Summary of Position Role/Responsibilities
Quzara seeks a highly skilled Senior SOC Engineer with a strong focus on engineering and automation to advance security operations. This role emphasizes the development of innovative solutions using machine learning, data science, and advanced analytics to enhance threat detection, streamline incident response, and improve overall SOC efficiency. The Senior SOC Engineer will work closely with cross-functional teams to architect and implement scalable, secure systems and processes. Candidates should have a BS in Computer Science, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related fields, with 7+ years of experience in security engineering or operations and relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GDSA, or AWS Security Specialty preferred).
Essential Functions of the Job

•
Security Engineering and Automation: Develop and deploy security automation solutions to enhance SOC workflows using SOAR tools, custom scripts, and orchestration frameworks.

•
Machine Learning for Threat Detection: Build and implement machine learning models to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies, and predict potential security threats.

•
Data Analytics and Visualization: Use data science techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, Power BI) to analyze security logs, generate actionable insights, and create dashboards for SOC teams.

•
Custom Tools Development: Design and develop custom security tools and applications to meet evolving organizational needs and enhance operational efficiency.

•
Threat Modeling and Behavioral Analytics: Create models to understand attacker behavior and map it to the MITRE ATT&CK framework for proactive threat identification.

•
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize tools like Terraform or Ansible to automate and secure SOC infrastructure, ensuring it remains scalable and robust.

•
Cloud Security Engineering: Collaborate with cloud engineering teams to implement security solutions within cloud-native environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

•
Mentorship and Leadership: Mentor junior SOC engineers, promote best practices in engineering, and provide technical leadership on security projects.

Marginal Functions of the Job

• Other duties as assigned

Normal Work Schedule
This is a full-time position. Standard business hours are Monday through Friday 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Additional time outside of these hours may be needed to complete the essential functions of the job.
Education, Training, and Experience

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field. Advanced degrees preferred.

•
Experience: 7+ years in security engineering, data science, or related areas.

•
Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with tools like Splunk, Sentinel, ELK stack, and SOAR platforms.

•
Data Science Skills: Proficiency in machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), and statistical modeling tools (e.g., R, Python).

•
Programming Skills: Strong programming/scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

•
Certifications: Preferred certifications include CISSP, GIAC (GDSA, GDAT), or cloud security credentials (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).

•
Cloud Knowledge: Proven experience with cloud-native security solutions and engineering practices.

•
Communication Skills: Strong communication skills with an ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Bookkeeper & Accounts Officer
Location: Remote, Philippines
Client location: Australia

Experience: At least 5 years of hands on bookkeeping in Xero, supporting Australian businesses
A subcontractor invoice doesn't match the supplier statement. A customer is questioning a fuel levy, and month end is close. You know which job records and proof of delivery to check, how to correct the ledger, and what the external accountant needs from you.
OutsourcedIn is recruiting an experienced Bookkeeper & Accounts Officer to support an Australian transport and freight business. You will manage day to day bookkeeping in Xero, reconcile accounts payable and receivable, and prepare records for BAS and tax review.
About Our Client
Our client is an Australian freight business that moves domestic freight for its customers. Its service depends on accurate bookings, well coordinated pickups and deliveries, and clear communication with customers when something changes along the way. It works with its own dispatch teams and drivers as well as subcontracted carriers.
The Role
You will keep the business's books accurate and up to date in Xero, from supplier and customer ledgers through to month end and BAS support. You will prepare payment runs for approval. The business approves and releases payments. You will work closely with customers, suppliers, the operations team and the external accountant.
What You Will Do
Accounts payable

• Process supplier and subcontractor invoices in Xero.

• Reconcile supplier statements to the Xero payables ledger, and investigate and resolve any discrepancies.

• Prepare payment runs and pass them on for approval.

Accounts receivable

• Raise customer invoices and allocate receipts and credits.

• Reconcile customer accounts to the Xero receivables ledger.

• Follow up overdue balances with customers.

Freight billing

• Check freight rates, fuel levies and other charges against job records and proof of delivery before they are billed.

• Resolve billing queries with customers, suppliers and the operations team.

Bank and month end reconciliations

• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts.

• Review aged payables and receivables, and investigate outstanding items before month end close.

BAS and tax support

• Review GST coding and reconcile GST accounts.

• Prepare BAS workpapers.

• Give the external accountant reconciled accounts and supporting records for BAS and year end tax review.

The Successful Applicant
You are an experienced bookkeeper who knows Xero well and understands how Australian businesses manage their accounts. You have worked with freight or logistics billing before, so you know how job records, rates and levies connect to an invoice.
Essential skills and experience

• At least 5 years of hands on bookkeeping experience in Xero.

• At least 5 years of bookkeeping or accounts experience supporting Australian businesses.

• Previous bookkeeping or accounts experience in transport, freight or logistics.

• Hands on experience reconciling AP and AR ledgers, including supplier statements, customer balances, credits and unapplied payments.

• Practical Australian BAS and tax support experience, including GST coding and reconciliation, BAS preparation and preparing records for year end tax review.

• Confidence using Excel and communicating with Australian customers, suppliers and internal teams.

Experience we would value

• Experience with a transport management system or freight job costing software.

• Experience processing Australian payroll in Xero.

Working Arrangements
This is a remote role based in the Philippines. You will be engaged as an independent contractor through OutsourcedIn .
